title: Boyfriend Claims Murdered Girlfriend Fell Down The Stairs
description:
Boris Lainez-Rosales calls 911 claiming his pregnant girlfriend, Leslianette Quintana-Betancourt, fell down the stairs. But evidence at the scene tells a very different story. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
